author: Bellular News
description:
You probably haven't heard of Delphi Interactive. They say they're the reason 007: First Light exists. But their latest game is, to quote Aftermath, "a modern hellscape".  It didn't go well. Now, they're hyping their future as they cut their studio to ribbons.

Join us at http://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
